# Sail trim

Trimming the sails sets their angle and shape to the wind. A well trimmed jib and mainsail drive the boat fast with little heel. Trim differs for each of the [[Points of sail]].

## Telltales

Wool telltales on the jib luff stream evenly when the sail is trimmed. If the windward ones lift, bear away or sheet in; if the leeward ones lift, head up or ease.

## Twist

Easing the mainsheet lets the top of the mainsail twist open and spill wind in gusts; sheeting hard flattens it for pointing upwind.
